ai_summary: This document is a routine compliance filing by Antarctica Limited to the NSE, fulfilling its obligation under SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. It confirms that all physical securities received for dematerialization during the specified period were properly processed, including mutilation, cancellation, and substitution of the depository's name, all within the mandated 15-day timeline. The filing demonstrates effective adherence to regulatory requirements for share dematerialization and exhibits no red flags, indicating sound operational compliance.
